name: Aryan Kapoor
bio:
Aryan Kapoor's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly during his undergraduate studies in economics. While volunteering at a local racing event to earn extra credit, he was captivated by the complex financial dynamics underpinning the sport. After graduating with honors, Aryan pursued a master's degree in financial management, tailoring his studies to focus on the unique challenges of motorsport finance, including managing volatile sponsor revenue and high development costs.

Prior to joining Target Racing, Aryan honed his skills at a smaller racing team, where he quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to fiscal responsibility. His approach to finance is rooted in the belief that strategic financial planning is crucial for achieving long-term success. He sees himself as more than just a number cruncher; he is a key member of the team, contributing to strategic decisions and ensuring the team operates efficiently. He is always looking for creative ways to optimize budgets, secure sponsorships, and maximize the team's financial performance.

What sets Aryan apart is his uncanny ability to identify potential financial risks and opportunities before they materialize. His analytical mind, combined with his passion for motorsport, makes him a valuable asset to any team.
